scope: Reconstructed bones-timeline C only: real findBoneIndex (recovered here), Json_getItem/getFloat, real readCurve on both branches, real setError with the console vcall and its Json_dispose argument, real spAnimation_dispose / spSkeletonData_dispose / spBoneData_dispose, real _malloc/_free. Synthetic boundaries: spTranslate/Rotate/Scale/ShearTimeline_create and spTranslate/RotateTimeline_setFrame recorders whose store shape follows the disassembled bodies (scale/shear setFrame thunks deliberately undefined), spCurveTimeline_setStepped/setCurve recorders, fixture heap, libc providers, hand-built Json nodes. Not an original-equivalence claim.
